name: Universidade de Aveiro
summary: Public campus university in Aveiro; its 59 first-cycle and integrated master's degrees teach in Portuguese; entry is via the national contest.

handoff.label: UA first-cycle and integrated master's degrees

ib.text: With Portuguese, apply through the national contest: IB grade 50%, IB exams replacing entrance exams 50%; IB Portuguese A at HL can replace the Portuguese exam (2026 table).

notes: The live catalogue labels 50 courses Portuguese and Chemical Engineering Portuguese with English support if needed; UA appendices label its eight blank fields Portuguese.
English tutorial support or reading lists do not make a complete degree English-taught.
UA's special call for international students is for non-European candidates; EU students apply through the national contest.
